description: §6.14.1 rule 2: `persist=` without `key=` is E-PERSIST-KEY-REQUIRED — the key is an external storage contract the author writes; the compiler never derives one from the cell's name.
rationale: §6.14.1 rule 2: "**`key=` is REQUIRED** on every `persist=` cell. `persist=` without `key=` SHALL be `E-PERSIST-KEY-REQUIRED`. The key is an external storage contract, written by the author; the compiler SHALL NOT derive one."
